description: This file defines the configuration and logic for authorization in the Kubernetes API server, including support for multiple authorization modes such as ABAC, RBAC, and Webhook, with functions for loading and validating authorization configurations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration structure for Kubernetes API server authorization, supporting multiple modes and reloading capabilities.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new authorizer based on the configuration, supporting reloads and multiple modes.

methods.name: GetNameForAuthorizerMode
methods.description: Returns the lowercase name for a given authorization mode.

methods.name: LoadAndValidateFile
methods.description: Loads and validates authorization configuration from a file.

methods.name: LoadAndValidateData
methods.description: Validates authorization configuration data loaded from a byte slice.
